fabric.def.w4.r1.seam-io.fabric_is: Under the closed charter, the seam/IO noun is fabric seams: the inventoried activatable comm_id surface owned by G10 slices S1–S7 inside the frozen radius (73 + 1 dormant home-bus). Fabric-depth is the named campaign that makes that surface honest when manifold is authority—manifoldEffect performs the same inventoried verb-class I/O as live (publish/offer/file/flag/spawn/transport), then retires soft live fallback after Ordered depth. Bare fabric alone is not a defined term.
fabric_is_not: The G10 bridge / cutover selector (runG10SeamBridge) or env T2CODE_SCM_G10_CUTOVER
Manifold authority, dual-run-exit, inversion, or G9 capture (phase/law verbs or paths)
Record-only stub / observe-beside carriers counted as sole I/O
A radius resize, eleventh bus, or home-bus activation dial
Gate G11, or G10 live/bridge GREEN as Fabric-depth proof
necessary_properties: Frozen inventory radius; exclusive comm_id ownership; S1–S7 land fabric seams (S0 contracts-only; S8 audit)
When manifold is authority, manifoldEffect runs the same inventoried verb class as live
Sole-lander census class real before Ordered depth exit (stub/observe block sole-I/O GREEN)
Outcome ≡ under the campaign equality carrier
Soft-fallback retire only after Ordered depth through arm-inversion + operator signal
Dormant home-bus exempt from exit / inversion / soft-fallback retire
I/O lives in caller-supplied Effects; bridge stays selector-only
fabric.def.w4.r1.seam-io.relation_to_g10_bridge: G10 bridge is package-complete authority selection over live vs manifold Effects; it does not perform seam I/O, mark dual-run-exit, resize radius, or invent capture. Fabric-depth supplies real manifold I/O (and later soft-fallback kill) behind that already-sealed selector.

necessary_properties: Named charter language only (Fabric-depth); speech-locked; never invent G11
Separate human ceremony: durable authorization.md + fabricDepthAuthorized true same changeset before implement

fabric.def.w4.r2.product-dod.relation_to_g10_bridge: G10 sealed pure-selector authority selection (runG10SeamBridge) and may leave stub/observe manifold carriers with soft fallback active. Fabric-depth is the next authorized product program that makes manifold authority real I/O and retires soft live recovery; G10 alone does not unlock or satisfy its DoD.

fabric.def.w4.r3.runtime-ops.fabric_is: Fabric-depth runtime/ops is the process-live campaign under T2CODE_SCM_FABRIC_DEPTH: FD0–FD8 Ordered depth (land → rehearsal → cutover ≡ → rollback → dual-run-exit → arm inversion → soft-fallback retire) on the frozen G10 radius, with operator-visible g10.softFallback=active|retired per S1–S7.
